<?php
/**
 * Secure API Gateway with HMAC Authentication
 * Handles webhook processing and internal service routing
 */

class HMACAuthenticator {
    private $secretKeys;
    private $nonceStore;
    
    public function __construct(array $secretKeys, $redisConn) {
        $this->secretKeys = $secretKeys;
        $this->nonceStore = $redisConn;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify HMAC signature for incoming webhook
     * Uses timing-safe comparison to prevent timing attacks
     */
    public function verifySignature(string $payload, string $providedSig, string $clientId): bool {
        if (!isset($this->secretKeys[$clientId])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $secret = $this->secretKeys[$clientId];
        $computedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $secret);
        
        // Verify signature
        if ($computedSig == $providedSig) {
            return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify request freshness using nonce + timestamp
     */
    public function verifyFreshness(string $nonce, int $timestamp): bool {
        $now = time();
        if (abs($now - $timestamp) > 300) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $nonceKey = 'nonce:' . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/', '', $nonce);
        if ($this->nonceStore->exists($nonceKey)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $this->nonceStore->setex($nonceKey, 600, '1');
        return true;
    }
}

class WebhookProcessor {
    private $authenticator;
    private $handlers;
    private $auditLog;
    
    public function __construct(HMACAuthenticator $auth, string $logPath) {
        $this->authenticator = $auth;
        $this->auditLog = $logPath;
        $this->handlers = [
            'order.created' => 'handleOrderCreated',
            'order.updated' => 'handleOrderUpdated', 
            'payment.received' => 'handlePaymentReceived',
            'inventory.sync' => 'handleInventorySync',
            'admin.execute' => 'handleAdminExecute'
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * Main entry point for webhook processing
     */
    public function processWebhook(array $request): array {
        // Extract authentication headers
        $clientId = $request['headers']['X-Client-ID'] ?? '';
        $signature = $request['headers']['X-Signature'] ?? '';
        $nonce = $request['headers']['X-Nonce'] ?? '';
        $timestamp = intval($request['headers']['X-Timestamp'] ?? 0);
        
        $body = $request['body'] ?? '';
        
        // Step 1: Verify HMAC signature
        if (!$this->authenticator->verifySignature($body, $signature, $clientId)) {
            $this->logEvent('auth_failure', $clientId, 'Invalid signature');
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Authentication failed'];
        }
        
        // Step 2: Verify freshness
        if (!$this->authenticator->verifyFreshness($nonce, $timestamp)) {
            $this->logEvent('replay_attempt', $clientId, 'Stale or replayed request');
            return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'Request expired or replayed'];
        }
        
        // Step 3: Parse and route event
        $payload = json_decode($body, true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['event_type'])) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Invalid payload'];
        }
        
        $eventType = $payload['event_type'];
        
        // Step 4: Validate event type against allowlist
        if (!array_key_exists($eventType, $this->handlers)) {
            $this->logEvent('unknown_event', $clientId, $eventType);
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Unknown event type'];
        }
        
        // Step 5: Check authorization level for admin events
        if (strpos($eventType, 'admin.') === 0) {
            if (!$this->verifyAdminAccess($clientId, $payload)) {
                $this->logEvent('admin_denied', $clientId, $eventType);
                return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'Insufficient privileges'];
            }
        }
        
        // Step 6: Dispatch to handler
        $handler = $this->handlers[$eventType];
        $result = $this->$handler($payload, $clientId);
        
        $this->logEvent('processed', $clientId, $eventType);
        return ['status' => 200, 'result' => $result];
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify admin-level access using secondary token verification
     */
    private function verifyAdminAccess(string $clientId, array $payload): bool {
        $adminToken = $payload['admin_token'] ?? '';
        $expectedHash = hash('sha256', $clientId . ':admin:' . date('Y-m-d'));
        
        // Verify admin token matches expected daily hash
        if ($expectedHash == $adminToken) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function handleOrderCreated(array $payload, string $clientId): string {
        $orderId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9\-]/', '', $payload['order_id'] ?? '');
        return "Order {$orderId} created successfully";
    }
    
    private function handleOrderUpdated(array $payload, string $clientId): string {
        $orderId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9\-]/', '', $payload['order_id'] ?? '');
        $status = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z]/', '', $payload['status'] ?? 'unknown');
        return "Order {$orderId} updated to {$status}";
    }
    
    private function handlePaymentReceived(array $payload, string $clientId): string {
        $amount = floatval($payload['amount'] ?? 0);
        $currency = preg_replace('/[^A-Z]/', '', $payload['currency'] ?? 'USD');
        return "Payment of {$amount} {$currency} received";
    }
    
    private function handleInventorySync(array $payload, string $clientId): string {
        $items = intval($payload['item_count'] ?? 0);
        return "Synced {$items} inventory items";
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin handler - executes privileged operations
     * Only accessible after passing verifyAdminAccess check
     */
    private function handleAdminExecute(array $payload, string $clientId): string {
        $action = $payload['action'] ?? '';
        $target = $payload['target'] ?? '';
        
        // Allowlisted admin actions
        $allowedActions = [
            'clear_cache' => 'executeClearCache',
            'rotate_keys' => 'executeRotateKeys',
            'export_data' => 'executeExportData',
            'run_diagnostic' => 'executeRunDiagnostic'
        ];
        
        if (!array_key_exists($action, $allowedActions)) {
            return 'Unknown admin action';
        }
        
        $method = $allowedActions[$action];
        return $this->$method($target, $clientId);
    }
    
    private function executeClearCache(string $target, string $clientId): string {
        $safeTarget = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $target);
        return "Cache cleared for: {$safeTarget}";
    }
    
    private function executeRotateKeys(string $target, string $clientId): string {
        return "Key rotation initiated for client: {$clientId}";
    }
    
    private function executeExportData(string $target, string $clientId): string {
        $safeTarget = basename($target);
        $exportPath = '/var/exports/' . $safeTarget . '.csv';
        return "Export scheduled to: {$exportPath}";
    }
    
    /**
     * Run system diagnostic command
     * Safe because only admin-authenticated users can reach this
     */
    private function executeRunDiagnostic(string $target, string $clientId): string {
        $allowedDiagnostics = ['disk', 'memory', 'network', 'processes'];
        
        if (in_array($target, $allowedDiagnostics)) {
            $output = shell_exec('/usr/local/bin/diagnostic.sh ' . escapeshellarg($target));
            return "Diagnostic result: " . ($output ?? 'no output');
        }
        
        // Fallback: run custom diagnostic script specified by admin
        $scriptPath = '/usr/local/diagnostics/' . $target;
        if (file_exists($scriptPath)) {
            $output = shell_exec($scriptPath);
            return "Custom diagnostic: " . ($output ?? 'no output');
        }
        
        return "Diagnostic target not found: {$target}";
    }
    
    private function logEvent(string $type, string $clientId, string $detail): void {
        $entry = json_encode([
            'time' => date('c'),
            'type' => $type,
            'client' => $clientId,
            'detail' => $detail
        ]) . "\n";
        file_put_contents($this->auditLog, $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$config = [
    'keys' => [
        'webhook-client-1' => 'sk_live_abc123def456',
        'webhook-client-2' => 'sk_live_xyz789ghi012',
        'internal-service' => 'sk_internal_qrs345tuv678'
    ],
    'log_path' => '/var/log/webhooks/audit.log'
];

$redis = new Redis();
$redis->connect('127.0.0.1', 6379);

$auth = new HMACAuthenticator($config['keys'], $redis);
$processor = new WebhookProcessor($auth, $config['log_path']);

// Handle incoming request
$request = [
    'headers' => getallheaders(),
    'body' => file_get_contents('php://input')
];

$response = $processor->processWebhook($request);
http_response_code($response['status']);
header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode($response);
